詞／曲：Jesse Cline, Maryanne J George, Dante Bowe, Aaron Moses, Chuck Butler

lines.b: Wandering into the night
Wanting a place to hide

lines.a: 我靈疲倦 肉體衰退
lines.b: This weary soul, this bag of bones
And I tried with all my mind
And I just can't win the fight

lines.a: 逐漸的飄蕩 無處為家
lines.b: I'm slowly drifting, oh vagabond
And just when I ran out of road
I met a man I didn't know

lines.a: 祂告訴我 我並沒有孤單
lines.b: And he told me that I was not alone

lines.a: 祂扶起我 脫離深淵
lines.b: He picked me up, He turned me around
He placed my feet on solid ground

lines.a: 我感謝我主 我的拯救者
lines.b: I thank the Master, I thank the Savior

lines.a: 祂醫治我的心 給我新名
lines.b: Because He healed my heart, He changed my name

lines.a: 永遠自由 煥然一新
lines.b: Forever free, I'm not the same

lines.a: 我感謝我主 我的拯救者
lines.b: I thank the Master, I thank the Savior
I thank God
I cannot deny what I seen
Got no choice but to believe
My doubts are burning
Like ashes in the wind
So, so long to my old friends

lines.a: 重擔 苦毒 再見
lines.b: Burden and bitter night
You can't just keep them moving
No, you ain't welcome here
From now 'til I walk the streets of gold
I'll sing of how you saved my soul

lines.a: 迷失孩子已找到路回家
lines.b: This wayward son has found his way back home

lines.a: 我不再屬於黑暗 我自由
lines.b: Hell lost another one, I am free
I am free, I am free
